description: This file implements a QoS container manager for Linux in Kubernetes, managing cgroups for different QoS classes, updating resource constraints periodically, and handling cgroup configurations for pods based on their QoS classification.

classes.name: qosContainerManagerImpl
classes.description: Implements the QOSContainerManager interface, managing cgroups for different QoS classes, updating resource constraints, and handling cgroup configurations.

classes.name: qosContainerManagerNoop
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of QOSContainerManager used when cgroups per QoS is disabled.

methods.name: NewQOSContainerManager
methods.description: Creates a new instance of qosContainerManagerImpl or a no-op if cgroups per QoS are disabled.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes QoS cgroups, creates necessary containers, and starts periodic updates.

methods.name: UpdateCgroups
methods.description: Updates resource constraints for QoS cgroups based on current pod states and system configuration.

methods.name: setHugePagesUnbounded
methods.description: Sets huge page limits to effectively unbounded for a cgroup configuration.

methods.name: setHugePagesConfig
methods.description: Applies huge page configuration to multiple QoS class configs.

methods.name: setCPUCgroupConfig
methods.description: Configures CPU shares for QoS classes based on active pods.

methods.name: getQoSMemoryRequests
methods.description: Calculates total memory requests for QoS classes based on active pods.

methods.name: setMemoryReserve
methods.description: Sets memory reservation limits for QoS classes based on system allocatable memory.

methods.name: retrySetMemoryReserve
methods.description: Adjusts memory limits if cgroups are over the set limit to prevent further growth.

methods.name: setMemoryQoS
methods.description: Configures memory.min for burstable and guaranteed QoS classes based on pod requests.
